title: Bengals still weighing decision on Myles Murphy's fifth-year option

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bengals still weighing decision on Myles Murphy's fifth-year option
sources.description: The deadline for teams to exercise the fifth-year options on the contracts of 2023 first-round picks is May 1 and it looks like the Bengals are gonna come right down to the wire on their Myles Murphy call.
